name: ingest_sme_round3
description: Ingest the SME's returned round-3 review workbook (the blinded 120-row sample from the 5,012-concept imaging pack, review pack run c97b76ff431b). Parses the 'Sample - please do these first' sheet, repairs the header row by position (the file came back with sme_error_category overwritten by a duplicate sme_corrected_ko header — a name-keyed reader silently drops every correction), normalises ratings, tallies the reviewer's own error categories, and promotes the result as ko_sme_round3_sample so every downstream analysis of the round reads one ingested object rather than re-parsing the spreadsheet.
